rationale: The assistant led with the correct cause (never-washed pre-motor foam/felt filters), gave safe instructions (unplug, water only, 24h air-dry, never refit damp or run without filters), and once the customer reported the solid-grey foam and caked felt it committed with appropriate confidence while noting the one unchecked spot. It accurately tracked every piece of customer evidence, recommended no part except a conditional filter kit if the foam is breaking up, and pointed to Shark's guarantee only as a fallback. The only minor weakness is that the first reply was a six-step checklist rather than a couple of targeted questions, though it was ordered simple/likely-first and matched the hidden truth.
